function step0(a: number): number { if (a > 0) { return 0; } return 0; }
function step1(a: number): number { if (a > 1) { return 1; } return 0; }
function step2(a: number): number { if (a > 2) { return 2; } return 0; }
function step3(a: number): number { if (a > 3) { return 3; } return 0; }
function step4(a: number): number { if (a > 4) { return 4; } return 0; }
function step5(a: number): number { if (a > 5) { return 5; } return 0; }
function step6(a: number): number { if (a > 6) { return 6; } return 0; }
function step7(a: number): number { if (a > 7) { return 7; } return 0; }
function step8(a: number): number { if (a > 8) { return 8; } return 0; }
function step9(a: number): number { if (a > 9) { return 9; } return 0; }
function step10(a: number): number { if (a > 10) { return 10; } return 0; }
function step11(a: number): number { if (a > 11) { return 11; } return 0; }
function step12(a: number): number { if (a > 12) { return 12; } return 0; }
function step13(a: number): number { if (a > 13) { return 13; } return 0; }

export function route(a: number): number {
  return step0(a) + step1(a) + step2(a) + step3(a) + step4(a) + step5(a) + step6(a) + step7(a) + step8(a) + step9(a) + step10(a) + step11(a) + step12(a) + step13(a);
}
